name: Inktrons #0093
description: Built for the opening bell. Inktrons #0093 is a Common Quadwall Sable, a four-screen monitor wall with a trading console, finished in Retro Quotron. Its screens stream MSTR (Strategy) with a climbing auction bid racing a countdown to SOLD alongside depth bars, line + volume, heatmap, worked by two arcade bid/ask buttons that slam down. It comes with a flag on top, an hourglass at its side and a server box in the corner. Set on a Neon Edge platform against a faint night grid. ERC404 on Ink, one of 180.
